items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: he would play what he wanted on the clarinet sound, he’d say, “Play something like this” but use your own style, use your own thing.

ctx.x: Tell me about — I have to ask about “Northern Exposure.”

That was a lot of fun. David Schwartz, who was the writer, that was the first time I had — not the first time, I had been with some people who had used synths. Now David is a bass player and used synth for whatever sounds he wanted, and he used that as when he did his work he would work on the synth and then he’d say, “Oh this ought to be a clarinet, and this ought to be a” so and so. And he would play me, when I came in he would play what he wanted on the clarinet sound, he’d say, “Play something like this” but…
